What’s next for AlmaLinux OS? In this video, I sit down with benny, Chair of the Board of Directors for the AlmaLinux OS Foundation, to talk about where the project is today and where it’s headed.

We cover a lot of ground: how AlmaLinux handled three back-to-back Linux kernel CVEs, the role Special Interest Groups (SIGs) play in the project, a new way for vendors to certify their hardware, open-source NVIDIA drivers, the AlmaLinux GNOME image, and how the “Creative Installer” fits into my own content creation workflow. We also get into how AlmaLinux leadership elections work, the story behind the slogan “No Drama, Just Linux,” how AI is affecting the project, and what the future looks like for 32-bit builds.
